description: Initial departments, profiles, and permission assignments for the Agora incumbent migration. Mirrors a typical public administration org chart so an existing PA can map its staff 1-to-1.

departments.name: Civil Registry
departments.description: Population register, identity records, and migration of existing citizens into the realm.

departments.name: Treasury & Tax Office
departments.description: Public finances, budgets, and (future) tax declarations and collection.

departments.name: Justice
departments.description: Courts, dispute resolution, and enforcement oversight.

departments.name: Public Works & Land
departments.description: Land zones, infrastructure, and the geographic organization of quarters.

departments.name: Administration
departments.description: Realm operations, role management, and lifecycle administration.
